reviews.author: 首尔外围Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: Judging by the reviews, this restaurant offers consistently good service and deserves a 4-star recommendation. When it comes to food, the signature steamed pork and steamed fish are well-received for their fresh ingredients and sophisticated seasoning, but some of the original dishes leave something to be desired. The service is very professional, food is served quickly, requests are responded to quickly and there is always a friendly smile even during peak times. The atmosphere is modern and minimalistic, with soft lighting and appropriate seating spacing making it suitable for family gatherings or business banquets. The price is reasonable and the portions are generous, making it excellent value for money. The downside is that there can be long waiting times on weekends, so advance booking is recommended. Parking space is limited, so using public transportation is more convenient. Overall, this restaurant offers a consistently high level of service and a relaxed atmosphere, making it suitable for customers looking for a dependable dining experience and worth a return visit.
